nameOrigin: used as a harder sound than ‘re’ to indicate a stronger character

pokedexEntries.bk: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

pokedexEntries.wh: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

pokedexEntries.sw: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.sh: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.
